name: Anoop Kumar
title: SENIOR JAVA TECHNICAL LEAD & SOLUTION ARCHITECT
summary: Agile-oriented software leader with 21+ years of engineering experience. Proven track record modernizing enterprise systems, architecting highly resilient microservices, and leading distributed cross-functional engineering teams.

experience.company: Simelabs – An Astek Company (formerly Sinergia Media Labs LLC)
desc: Presales & RFP Architecture: Conducted technical analysis, requirement scoping, and effort estimation for incoming Java enterprise leads; presented solutions directly to international clients to help finalize formal RFPs.

GIC Singapore Modernization (Onsite): Executed a 2.5-month onsite architectural assessment and codebase audit. Analyzed a vulnerable legacy ecosystem (including EJB, Struts, JSP, Spring Boot, and EOL Apache Olingo 2) and upgraded core apps to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x.

West Health Platform: Analyzed the open-source Project EKA architecture to design a custom, FHIR-compliant medical telemetry framework. Self-learned JS/TS to engineer Vue.js front-ends and NestJS backend APIs.

AutoRABIT M11N Salesforce Modernization: Collaborated within a core team to decompose monolithic Salesforce CI/CD systems into microservices; engineered the end-to-end lifecycle of the Data Loader microservice using Spring Boot and ELK stack.

CSG (Cloud Software Group) Demo Center: Provided production support, deep codebase analysis, and resolution for critical platform issues while engineering features within a modular monolithic framework.

NFC Services: Designed and architected high-throughput backend microservices to securely expose core business functionalities for third-party API integration. Mentored team and conducted peer code reviews.
Technically managed and developed backend REST services for IHG using an Agile approach (2019-2020).
Agile development of hybrid mobile applications integrating WIDEN and Office 365 APIs for GE Healthcare (2016-2018).
Developed a Proof of Concept using Python and the ELK stack for calculating IPTE metrics for GE Healthcare (2018).
Managed, maintained, and supported Nielsen Audio applications with a dedicated engineering team of 10 (2014-2015).
Developed and maintained diverse desktop and web products for Arbitron, focusing primarily on Tapscan.
Designed, developed, and deployed a custom, reusable Multiselect Component using JSF and EJS Treegrid.
Involved in the development and maintenance of high-volume service delivery systems for clients Sprint & CenturyLink.
Involved in the development of Point of Sale (POS) applications using the Oracle 360 Tour Framework.
Involved in core product development for an insurance management system tailored for third-party insurance companies (DSRM).
Technically managed and mentored a team of 3 engineers in modernizing their technology stack.
Completed intensive training in core Java web frameworks and assisted with development.
